{{Top|leg}}
"'''Therapod'''" was a class of predatory reptilians. [[Tiss'shar/Legends|Tiss'shar]] were regarded as therapods.<ref name="UAA">''[[Ultimate Alien Anthology]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The word "[[Wikipedia:Theropoda|theropod]]" means "beast foot," and was coined by paleontologist [[Wikipedia:Othniel Charles Marsh|Othniel Charles Marsh]] in 1881 to describe the group of [[Dinosaur/Legends|dinosaurs]] consisting of bipedal carnivores (although later studies have found omnivorous and herbivorous members of the group). Such famous genera as [[Wikipedia:Tyrannosaurus|''Tyrannosaurus'']], [[Wikipedia:Allosaurus|''Allosaurus'']], and [[Wikipedia:Velociraptor|''Velociraptor'']] were theropods.

Though spelled with an "o" in real life, the ''[[Ultimate Alien Anthology]]'' spells "therapod" with an "a."
